calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as gold_member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT tier, COUNT(*) as member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

SELECT COUNT(*) as null_tier_count
FROM dim_member

SELECT COUNT(*) as future_valid_to_count
FROM dim_member

SELECT valid_to, COUNT(*) as member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
